content: Well, hello, Mr. Atkins. I haven't seen you for weeks, where have you been all this time?
Oh, I've just been to Japan on business.
You sure get around. How many countries have you been to?
Pretty close to 60 countries now. I guess I'm a real world traveler.
Well, if you aren't, I don't know who is.
Maybe someday, I'll settle down here. I just can't seem to stay in one place for very long.
How many years have you been traveling?
I've been with the company for 25 years and traveling all the time.
